PropertyList.title: SeaMax m22
PropertyList.line: Turn at least one of the fuel selectors located above the side windows.
On the overhead panel, open the red security cap and turn on the master switch
Switch the fuel pump on and check for fuel pressure on the instrument located on the copilot part of the panel
Turn the magnetos to "both" position by clicking on the key or pressing "}" 3 times
Start the engine by clicking the key or pressing "s"
Flaps 10, full power, lift nose at 45-50kts, rotate at 60kts
On leveled cruise, use the -5 deg flaps to earn some extra kts.
